summary: Dowry demand allegations intertwined with civil property dispute; FIR allegations examined beyond surface level; husband's civil suit against family precedes criminal complaint; identical witness statements raise doubt; High Court's failure to analyze frivolity/vexatiousness in exercising Section 482 CrPC quashing jurisdiction; duty to scrutinize manifestly abusive proceedings citing Mohammad Wajid precedent; quashing upheld due to absence of specific allegations, general omnibus nature, and ulterior motive to influence civil suit.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order setting aside quashing of FIR reversed; criminal proceedings quashed.
